name: Negative Form Validation Flows -- @1.1

steps.name: Given I navigate to the MakeMyTrip homepage
When I dismiss the login popup and click on the hotels module
When I search for the hotel destination "Bali"
And I trigger the search query
And I apply the 5-star filter on the results page
And I select the first hotel and click Book Now
And I fill guest details from test_case.csv scenario "Negative_Missing_FirstName"
And I handle secure trip and continue
Then the application should handle the constraint for "Negative_Missing_FirstName"

fullName: Hotel Booking Validation Suite: Negative Form Validation Flows
